description: Custom instruction to accelerate 2-element floating-point dot products for matrix multiplication, complying with RED memory ABI and PicoRV32 area/IRQ constraints.

instructions.name: Floating-point 2-element Dot Product
instructions.semantics: Reads a 5-word input memory block pointed to by rs1 and writes to a 5-word output memory block pointed to by rs2. The instruction writes 0 to rd. The input block contains five IEEE-754 single-precision floats: a0, a1, b0, b1, and c (mapped to in[0..4]). The instruction computes the dot product accumulation: res = c + (a0 * b0) + (a1 * b1). It performs two multiplications (a0*b0 and a1*b1) and two additions (c + (a0*b0) and the final sum) strictly in that sequence. To guarantee bit-exact determinism across host architectures, any NaN generated by any operation (or passed as an operand that propagates) is immediately canonicalized to 0x7FC00000 before the next step. It uses RNE rounding mode. The final 32-bit floating-point result is written to out[0], and out[1..4] are zero-padded. Exceptions are silently ignored.

name: FloatAccelerator
tests: link1: coverage 99.37% >= 80%; 1/1 C models built and survived 100,000 vectors under ASan+UBSan
gate2: 1/1 instructions: C model and patched Spike agree on 100,000 random + corner vectors
